svg.data-power-input: AC, single or dual, C13 connector: 100 - 240 VAC, 50 - 60 Hz, 2.4 A max for each supply (A100, A200, C100, C200). Dual DC with supplied Phoenix connectors: 48 VDC, 2.9 A max for each supply (AD00, CD00)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: product page: "(2) 10 Gb capable SFP+ sockets"; the page names no optic and none is included
svg.data-serial-modes: RS-232 (A models); RS-232, RS-422 and RS-485 software selectable (C models, MEI)
svg.data-emissions: CE; RED; FCC Part 15, Subpart B; ICES-003; AS/NZS; CISPR 32, CISPR 35
